h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rewa

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rewa

items.pText: Rewa is the main city of the Vindhya region in north-eastern Madhya Pradesh, known for its waterfalls and as the place where India's white tigers were first found. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, colonies and parks across the city and district. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,040 km away, and delivered by road.

One early decision for any buyer is whether to buy separate pieces or one large structure. The answer depends on the shape of your ground, the number of children and the budget. Tell us those three things and send a few photos. We will suggest a mix and send a layout drawing showing the safe play area, so you can compare options side by side before you order.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Separate pieces or a multi play station

c: Individual equipment, such as swings, slides, see-saws and merry-go-rounds, spreads children across the ground and suits long or irregular plots. Each piece needs its own safe play area, so the total space used is larger. A
combines slides, climbers and decks into one footprint. It suits compact square plots and keeps a group of children together.

facts.value: About 1,040 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Which is better for a small ground, individual pieces or a combined structure?
items.a: On a compact, square plot a combined structure usually fits more play into less space. On a long or irregular plot, separate pieces spread out more easily. We will advise once we see the measurements.

items.q: Can you supply schools in Rewa district as well as the city?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India, and our installation team or a local dealer installs on site, including in the smaller towns around Rewa.

items.q: How many colours can we choose from?
items.a: Our roto-moulded parts come in more than 15 colour shades. You can pick a scheme that matches your school or society, and we confirm it with you before manufacturing starts.
